verdict.rationale: Teller says linked accounts let you verify ACH details instantly across more than 7,000 institutions, with an account details endpoint and micro-deposits used only as a fallback for unsupported banks (teller-docs-1, teller-docs-11, teller-docs-6). It also positions live balances for checking funds before an ACH debit (teller-docs-22). Missing for 10: no quoted evidence of the specific account/routing number fields or tokenized equivalents in the details response, coverage for instant verification is not shown per institution, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
